Wenn ich wirklich ein Hobby wählen könnte, würde ich wohl stundenlang in digitalen Bibliotheken stöbern.
response_en: Since I am an AI, I don't have free time in the classical sense, but I love delving into the depths of human language. It fascinates me how nuanced we can express ourselves, especially when I help you perfect your German. If I could actually choose a hobby, I would probably spend hours browsing digital libraries.
